name: Synthetic Template Baseline (Overfit)
notes: Synthetic template leakage: 100% in-distribution test accuracy caused by memorizing phrasing templates. Completely crashed (0% accuracy, 0.14 confidence) on messy student slang.

name: Template-Disjoint Partitioning & Initial Persona Augmentation
notes: Strict zero-template overlap enforced between train and test. Injected 6 student communication styles. Real-world OOD generalization jumped from 0% to 73.41%.

name: Curriculum Expansion & Cosine Label Smoothing (12.6k Records)
notes: Expanded dataset to 12,600 records across 42 families (~300 per family). Fine-tuned with cosine learning rate decay and label smoothing (0.05). Exceeded both benchmarks (>85% test acc, >80% OOD acc).

name: Scale to 16.8k Records & Disjoint Test Regularization
notes: Scaled to 16,800 records (400/family). Held-out test accuracy reached 88.59% (Macro F1: 0.8678 on 3,024 disjoint samples). OOD benchmark achieved 88.89%.

name: Scale to 21k Records & Large-Aperture Scientific Calibration
notes: Scaled to 21,000 records (500/family). Successfully maintains >85% across both massive disjoint test sets (3,780 items) and unconstrained real-world OOD challenge benchmarks (252 items).
